metadata.description: xsolana: economies on loot, one shared Solana program, for any coding agent.

plugins.name: xsolana
plugins.description: Build web3 and game economies on Solana without writing a smart contract: shops, loot boxes, lotteries, auctions, staking farms, crafting, contests, rewards and outside NFTs on loot, one shared program. Design, check, simulate and price an economy; it goes live signed by a key file on the owner's own machine, after their yes.
